Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal, and the crowd erupts in applause as the officials announce that Jasper has been awarded the world record for oldest human to ever live.

**JASPER** (overcome with emotion)
Oh, thank you, thank you so much! I'm just a lucky man!

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Jasper lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He gazes at the medal, a look of nostalgia washing over his face. As he drifts off to sleep, he begins to recall a theory he read on the internet many years ago.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
I remember reading about Quantum Immortality. The idea that every time a person dies, their consciousness creates a new universe, and they live on in that new reality. It was just a theory, but it stuck with me.

As Jasper's mind wanders, he becomes increasingly agitated. He starts to pace back and forth in his bed, his eyes wide with excitement.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
What if it's true? What if I'm not really dead? What if I'm just living in a different universe?

Jasper's pace quickens, and he begins to speak to himself in a frantic tone.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
I've been living in a different universe this whole time! I've been living in a different universe, and I've been keeping it a secret from everyone!

As the minutes tick by, Jasper's mental state deteriorates. He starts to laugh maniacally, his eyes rolling back in his head.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
I'm not just 127 years old, I'm infinite! I'm a quantum immortal!

The camera zooms in on Jasper's face, his eyes wild and unhinged.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
I'm the only one who knows the truth! I'm the only one who knows that I'm living in a multiverse, and that I'm the only one who can see it!

As the camera continues to zoom in, Jasper's face begins to distort, his features melting away like wax in a furnace.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
I'm not Jasper Jenkins, I'm the universe itself! I'm the quantum immortal, and I'm going to take over the multiverse!

The camera spins wildly, capturing Jasper's descent into madness.

**FADE TO BLACK.**

**THE END.**
